faq.q: Is every property on the farms portal a working farm?
faq.a: No — as read, its describable cards include two unbuilt agricultural Land parcels, a hobby-farm acreage that is not in the ALR, a 0.63-acre residential lot with farm-adjacent zoning permissions, and a rancher whose card text connects it to farming only by backing onto a farm. Read each card on its own text.

faq.q: Does buying farm land automatically keep its farm classification?
faq.a: No — classification is a voluntary, property-by-property BC Assessment program with income thresholds by operation size, and a buyer who plans to continue farming must submit a General Application for Farm Classification by October 31 after purchase or the classification can be removed.
